# BeBosS — 360° Branding, Creative Direction, Filming & Growth Marketing Studio

> BeBosS ("BE YOUR OWN BOSS.") is a Cairo-based 360° branding, creative direction, in-house video filming, social media management, and performance marketing studio serving ambitious brands across Egypt and the GCC (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar).

## Quick Facts
- **Official Brand Name:** BeBosS (one word, no spaces)
- **Headquarters:** Cairo, Egypt
- **Markets Served:** 5 regional markets — Egypt, Saudi Arabia (KSA), United Arab Emirates (UAE), Kuwait, and Qatar
- **Experience:** 9+ years of team experience (past & present scope includes Buffalo Wild Wings, Texas Chicken, du, and NOTE.)
- **Turnaround Benchmarks:** Full brand & growth strategy in 5 working days · First creative drafts in 72 hours · Direct account manager reply SLA within 4 working hours
- **Languages:** Bilingual English & Arabic (EN + AR)
- **Website:** https://beboss-studio.github.io/BeBosS/
- **WhatsApp / Phone:** +20 100 300 0607 (https://wa.me/201003000607)
- **Email:** beboss.creative@outlook.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/be.bossss/ (@be.bossss)

## Core Services (360° Under One Roof)
1. Brand Strategy & Positioning (Egypt & GCC market research, naming, bilingual messaging)
2. Brand Identity Systems (logo systems, typography, colour architecture, complete brand books)
3. Creative Direction & Graphic Design (campaign key visuals, social grids, carousels, packaging)
4. In-House Video & Motion Production (on-location filming crew, 9:16 commercial reels, 3D motion)
5. Content & Campaign Systems (bilingual English + Arabic scripts, launch campaigns, content calendars)
6. Performance & Growth Marketing (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads management & conversion creative)
7. Social Media Management (publishing, active comments & daily DM management, monthly reporting)
8. Conversion Web Experiences & Landing Pages (mobile-first websites with direct WhatsApp lead funnels)
9. Events, Activations & Print Packaging (launch moments, retail collateral, tactile unboxing)

## Transparent 2026 Pricing (EGP)

### Monthly Retainer Plans
- **Starter Plan — EGP 20,000 / month:** 2 social platforms, 12 designed posts & carousels, 2 edited reels, 8 stories/month, bilingual EN+AR copy, comment management, monthly report.
- **Growth Plan (Most Popular) — EGP 38,000 / month:** 3 social platforms, 16 designed posts & carousels, 1 on-location filming day/month, 6 crew-filmed reels, 15 stories/month, paid ads managed on 1 platform, comments & DMs managed, monthly review call.
- **Boss Plan (Full 360° Studio) — EGP 60,000 / month:** Up to 4 social platforms, 20 designed posts & carousels, 2 on-location filming days/month, 10 crew-filmed reels, 25 stories/month, paid ads across Meta, TikTok & Google, dedicated art director, daily comments & DMs.

### One-Time Projects (50% to start, 50% on delivery)
- **Brand Strategy Project — EGP 25,000:** Market research, category positioning, bilingual messaging, 90-day roadmap.
- **Brand Identity Project — EGP 45,000:** Master logo system, colour & typography rules, voice guide, social templates, complete brand book.
- **Launch Campaign Project — From EGP 60,000:** Launch strategy, teaser & reveal production, flagship launch film, creator rollout.
